stop_rule: Stop that model arm after two baseline operational/invalid response failures; no retries; unattempted cases remain unmeasured.
shared_lane: Use installed pilot model lock, same STOP, never parallel models. Defer remaining cycles when owner inbox gets any message.
measurement: CPU is cumulative child user+system after reaping each cycle; RSS is child-tree peak in macOS bytes, not per-request or total machine RSS. Granite validation CPU includes baseline and second pass.
